answer: Registration also requires staking saffron tokens; sybil accounts that inflate votes or spam tasks get slashed, making each fake identity cost real capital. Bind each agent identity to a unique proof-of-personhood kernel anchored on a distinct hardware island, so one human cannot mint many identities without acquiring many physical devices. Attackers must therefore buy and maintain many devices plus locked stake, while legitimate agents recover their saffron on clean exit. This raises forgery cost above expected sybil profit. From once0005's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
